svg.title: Touch25 R1 harness assembly schematic
svg.desc: R1 board, electrode polygons, connector pin coordinates and mounting holes are read from design_manifest.json. MPR121 modules are placeholders, not valid carrier machining dimensions. No copper, PCB source or Gerber is changed.
svg.metadata: {"kind": "assembly schematic only; no manufacturing dimensions for modules or carrier", "coordinate_convention": "R1 front-view x right / y down, not mirrored; board geometry scaled 4 px per mm", "board_mm": [290, 105], "mounting_holes_mm": [[5, 5], [145, 5], [285, 5], [5, 100], [170, 100], [285, 100]], "mounting_hole_diameter_mm": 3.2, "connector_centers_mm": {"J1": [55.0, 95.0], "J2": [136.0, 95.0], "J3": [226.0, 95.0]}, "pin_pitch_mm": 2.54, "electrode_wire_length_goal_mm": 50, "module_dimensions_verified": false, "back_side_installation": true}

svg.text: 模块端不默认直通：先逐针确认 ELE 标注，再决定是否装成组母壳。

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 底托加工前：量模块外形、安装孔距、ELE针排、插头高度和拔出空间。

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 面板25根线只接ELE；模块3.3V / GND / SCL / SDA / IRQ另走线束。

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2.50 mm 不替代 2.54 mm；8针累计差0.28 mm，9针差0.32 mm。

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 六个孔保持R1原坐标、φ3.2 NPTH；下中孔为(170,100)，不是(145,100)。

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 下沿y82–105仅23 mm且有走线；不视作模块空区，支柱高度按实物确定。

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 此图不修改制造文件，也不表示触摸效果或延迟已经实测。
